title: Add AGENTS.md with Cursor Cloud development instructions
body: ## Summary Adds `AGENTS.md` with Cursor Cloud-specific development environment instructions for future agents. ### What's included - Service overview table (PostgreSQL + Next.js dev server) with startup commands - Reference to common commands from `package.json` and `README.md` - Non-obvious caveats discovered during setup: - Prisma 7+ uses `prisma.config.ts` for database URL (not schema block) - No test framework or test files in the repo currently - Environment variables have development fallbacks - Database must exist before starting dev server - Uses `prisma db push` (no migration files yet) ### Environment verification All checks pass: - PostgreSQL running and accepting connections - Next.js dev server starts on port 3000 - API health endpoint returns `{ "ok": true }` - User registration, login, and authenticated endpoints work end-to-end - Lint, typecheck, and build all pass cleanly ### Demo [tivaid_registration_login_demo.mp4](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-8c350151-6e76-43f9-bd2c-8c9e50ad78cd/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Ftivaid_registration_login_demo.mp4) [TivAid Homepage](https://cursor.com/agents/bc-8c350151-6e76-43f9-bd2c-8c9e50ad78cd/artifacts?path=%2Fopt%2Fcursor%2Fartifacts%2Ftivaid_homepage.webp) To show artifacts inline, enable in settings.
